coast-tide-runner.name: tide-cut cargo runner
coast-tide-runner.counterplay: guard the load or cut off its marked shoreward escape

coast-dune-hunter.name: dune longbow hunter
coast-dune-hunter.counterplay: use wreck cover, smoke, or the landward gully

coast-wreck-shield.name: wreck shield bearer
coast-wreck-shield.counterplay: pull the bearer away or change elevation

coast-salt-slinger.name: salt-bank slinger
coast-salt-slinger.capability: casts while withdrawing across firm flats
coast-salt-slinger.counterplay: close through deep mud or deny loose stone

coast-netter.name: mudflat netter
coast-netter.capability: marks a net lane that worsens current
coast-netter.counterplay: move before the cast or cut the anchor rope

coast-lookout.name: signal-mast lookout
coast-lookout.counterplay: remain unseen, distract, or interrupt the signal

coast-elite.name: storm-chain captain
coast-elite.capability: changes the escape route by hauling a tide chain
coast-elite.counterplay: release the windlass, isolate support, or leave before the channel fills

coast-elite-wreck.name: wreck-chain reeve
coast-elite-wreck.capability: hauls wreck cover out of a telegraphed firing lane
coast-elite-wreck.counterplay: move behind fixed dunes, dog the chain, or present the witnessed wreck account

forest-trail-watch.name: charcoal trail watcher
forest-trail-watch.capability: recognises disturbed brush and signal birds
forest-trail-watch.counterplay: move crosswind, use water, or silence the signal

forest-resin-hunter.name: resinwood bow hunter
forest-resin-hunter.capability: tracks last-known positions through canopy gaps
forest-resin-hunter.counterplay: change trail, enter dense growth, or use smoke downwind

forest-hook.name: coppice hook runner
forest-hook.capability: uses side trails toward the courier's last-known flank
forest-hook.counterplay: hold a narrow bridge or reverse through a loop

forest-smoke-tender.name: illicit burn smoke-tender
forest-smoke-tender.capability: feeds smoke into a watched clearing
forest-smoke-tender.counterplay: change wind at the shutter or quench the pit

forest-tusker.name: charcoal-bristled tusker
forest-tusker.capability: charges toward loud movement but stops beyond its wallow
forest-tusker.counterplay: distract with sound, climb, or circle outside its territory

forest-pack-runner.name: hidden-store pack runner
forest-pack-runner.capability: takes opened-cache goods and exits by a side trail
forest-pack-runner.counterplay: secure the pack or block the escape trail

forest-elite.name: ash-cloak fire warden
forest-elite.capability: redirects smoke and closes one clearing while support lives
forest-elite.counterplay: quench two feed points, change wind, or remove the signal watcher

forest-elite-resin.name: resin-fire tracker
forest-elite-resin.capability: marks a resin patch, then ignites it into rising smoke
forest-elite-resin.counterplay: leave the marked patch, cross water, or preserve the medicine coppice

upland-ridge-slinger.name: ridge sling ward
upland-ridge-slinger.counterplay: take the switchback underhang or contest the ridge

upland-pike.name: quarry pike holder
upland-pike.counterplay: hook, net, climb around, or negotiate the toll

upland-scree-runner.name: scree-side flanker
upland-scree-runner.capability: descends unstable scree without losing footing
upland-scree-runner.counterplay: trigger controlled rockfall or hold firm ground

upland-lime-tender.name: lime-kiln smoke tender
upland-lime-tender.capability: vents caustic smoke across a lane
upland-lime-tender.counterplay: close the vent, approach from above, or wait crosswind

upland-cave-hound.name: pale quarry hound
upland-cave-hound.capability: tracks sound through connected cave levels
upland-cave-hound.counterplay: throw sound into a side shaft or reach daylight

upland-alarm-climber.name: bell-rope climber
upland-alarm-climber.capability: climbs directly toward the warning bell
upland-alarm-climber.counterplay: cut the rope, block the ladder, or remain below the parapet

upland-elite.name: false-bell quarry master
upland-elite.capability: rings marked rockfall lanes and retreats between levels
upland-elite.counterplay: sever the bell line, shelter under arches, or expose the false toll

upland-elite-bridge.name: bridge-breaker bellward
upland-elite-bridge.capability: marks a floor brace before breaking its crossing and changing elevation
upland-elite-bridge.counterplay: leave the marked brace, use the lower switchback, or ring the honest warning

hearth-bank-lookout.name: bank-road toll watch
hearth-bank-lookout.capability: patrols a finite road circuit and signals only its own watch
hearth-bank-lookout.reaction: returns to the road after a broken sightline
hearth-bank-lookout.counterplay: leave its sightline or interrupt the signal; a side meadow bypasses the patrol

hearth-reed-boar.name: bristleback reed boar
hearth-reed-boar.capability: telegraphs a charge and bogs in deep mud
hearth-reed-boar.reaction: circles after a guarded or redirected charge
hearth-reed-boar.counterplay: lead it into mud or use controlled light; distance breaks the charge

hearth-roof-keeper.name: watch-roof crossbow keeper
hearth-roof-keeper.capability: uses aligned ladders and a heavy prepared roof lane
hearth-roof-keeper.reaction: reloads twice after a visible telegraphed shot
hearth-roof-keeper.counterplay: break line below the roof or climb through the aligned opening; smoke interrupts aim

hearth-mill-protector.name: displaced mill levy
hearth-mill-protector.capability: interposes for the gantry carrier and covers a wounded withdrawal
hearth-mill-protector.reaction: abandons pursuit when its paired carrier needs cover
hearth-mill-protector.counterplay: separate it with a hook or take the culvert loop; witnessed mill terms can end the levy

hearth-gantry-suppressor.name: gantry sling carrier
hearth-gantry-suppressor.capability: marks a missile lane and feeds smoke through a bounded gantry vent
hearth-gantry-suppressor.reaction: holds cover while its paired levy withdraws
hearth-gantry-suppressor.counterplay: move before release or climb under the lane; wind and water clear its smoke

hearth-cargo-reaver.name: valuable-seeking river reaver
hearth-cargo-reaver.capability: takes one physical valuable and escapes toward a named home route
hearth-cargo-reaver.reaction: drops the exact stolen item if intercepted
hearth-cargo-reaver.counterplay: carry fewer exposed valuables or block its homeward line; morale loss forces retreat

hearth-elite-claimant.name: floodgate claimant
hearth-elite-claimant.capability: telegraphs and floods a three-cell mill crossing
hearth-elite-claimant.counterplay: dog the sluice, use the upper gantry, or establish the public compact

STANDARD_REACTIONS.lookout: returns to its patrol after an interrupted alarm
STANDARD_REACTIONS.flanker: changes to a side route when the direct lane is held
STANDARD_REACTIONS.protector: covers a wounded ally before resuming pursuit
STANDARD_REACTIONS.shooter: seeks elevation or reloads after a telegraphed shot
STANDARD_REACTIONS.skirmisher: withdraws when the courier enters its preferred range
STANDARD_REACTIONS.suppressor: marks a lane and feeds smoke before direct pressure
STANDARD_REACTIONS.territorial: returns home when prey or courier leaves its boundary
STANDARD_REACTIONS.thief: escapes toward home after taking one physical item
STANDARD_REACTIONS.tracker: investigates sound or prey without learning an unseen courier position
STANDARD_REACTIONS.controller: recovers a missed marked restraint before casting again
